name: lexapi_search_legislation
description: Search EU legislation (EUR-Lex) by meaning. Returns matching articles, each followed by a Source line with its CELEX citation. With as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) it asks for the text for that date; an article whose text LexAPI did not establish for that date comes back as a notice without text. Consolidated texts have no legal force; the Source line names the act to cite when LexAPI knows it.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

as_of.description: Optional date, YYYY-MM-DD: return the text for that date. Leave it out for the latest text.

name: lexapi_read_document
description: Read an EU document by its CELEX number: one article (article argument), or its articles in order. Each passage is followed by a Source line with its CELEX citation. Consolidated texts (CELEX starting with 0) have no legal force: cite the act as published in the Official Journal. The output is limited by a character budget of 20000 characters of text; the articles not shown are listed by reference.

celex.description: CELEX number of the document, for example 32016R0679.

article.description: Optional article to read: art_17, 17 or 'Article 17'. Leave it out to read the document's articles from the start.

language.description: Optional language of the text (ISO 639-1, for example en).

name: lexapi_legislation_as_of
description: Get the version of an EU act listed for a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and, optionally, one provision of it (art_17, anx_III, rct_26-28). If LexAPI cannot establish the text for that date, you get a notice with the reason and no text. It does not say whether a provision applied on that date. Consolidated texts have no legal force; the Source line names the act to cite when LexAPI knows it.

celex.description: CELEX number of an EU regulation, directive or decision, for example 32016R0679.

provision.description: Optional article (art_17), annex (anx_III) or recitals (rct_26-28). Leave it out to get only the version for the date.

language.description: Optional language of the text (ISO 639-1, for example en).
